name: Personal identity & context switcher — approval frames
description: Contract-freeze UX artifacts for the reconciled identity/tenancy model: the user identity is the base principal, signup makes a user a member of the root FuzeFront org (the platform tenant), and orgs are opt-in tenants. Operating 'as yourself' is a first-class Personal (non-org) context; the root org shows a MEMBER badge, never GUEST; type='personal' orgs are dropped. Unifies the local <select> in OrganizationPage.tsx and the persisted setActiveOrganization in UserMenu.tsx into one ContextSwitcher. Approving a flow approves its visual + interaction model AND the component/package build inventory before UI implementation. frontend-test-engineer drives Playwright against these via the data-frame / data-* hooks.

commissionedByApproval: A Personal (non-org) context as a first-class switcher target — not represented by a type='personal' org row (that type is dropped)

The root org resolving to user_role='member' so the root GUEST 'you're not a member' state is RETIRED in favour of a MEMBER badge — depends on the fuzefront.identity.root-membership backend slice writing the root membership row
Active-context selection persisted via setActiveOrganization (client-side), superseding the page-local <select> in OrganizationPage.tsx — no new server endpoint

frames.label: (a) Personal context
frames.summary: Operating 'as yourself': the non-org Personal home. Context pill reads 'Personal'; personal-scope app installs (keyed to userId) and a shortcut into your organizations. No tenant nav.
frames.acceptanceNotes: The Personal context is NOT backed by a type='personal' org — the identity is the principal. data-context='personal' on the root; the context pill carries data-context-pill and data-context='personal'. Personal app installs render regardless of active org because they key to userId. There is no owner/admin org chrome in this context.

frames.label: (b) Org context — root MEMBER
frames.summary: Inside the root FuzeFront org. The access badge is MEMBER (never GUEST) because signup wrote a real root membership row. Owner/admin actions do not appear for a member.
frames.acceptanceNotes: data-org is the pinned root id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010. data-role='member' and data-context-badge='member' MUST be present and the string 'GUEST'/'not a member' MUST NOT appear for root. This asserts the retirement of the #529 GUEST state once root-membership is on. Admin-only controls are absent for role=member.

frames.label: (c) Context switcher
frames.summary: The unified switcher menu: Personal + your orgs and nested sub-orgs, each with your role pill, an active check on the current context, persisted via setActiveOrganization. Create-org entry at the foot.
frames.acceptanceNotes: One menu reconciling OrganizationPage's local <select> and UserMenu's setActiveOrganization — selection persists, it is not page-local. Personal is a menuitemradio with data-switch-target='personal', not an org row. Org rows carry data-switch-target=<orgId> and data-role; sub-orgs render nested (data-switch-target for the child org). The active row has aria-checked='true' and the check glyph. Role pills come from user_role, never hard-coded.

frames.label: (d) My orgs & sub-orgs
frames.summary: Manage the orgs you own or belong to, each with your role pill and its sub-org tree; create a new org. Direct memberships only — access held through a parent/root org has no row.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Rows render from GET /api/organizations (each with user_role). data-list='my-orgs'; each org-card carries data-org and data-role. Sub-orgs render under their parent in data-list='sub-orgs'. The list shows DIRECT active memberships only — inherited (parent/root/reseller ReBAC) access has no card here, by omission. Create-org is POST /api/organizations.

frames.label: (e) States
frames.summary: Loading skeleton (aria-busy), empty (Personal + root only), provisioning gate, switch error+retry, fail-closed 403-in-place when switching into an org you no longer belong to, and inline create-org validation.
frames.acceptanceNotes: e1 loading = aria-busy skeleton for GET /api/organizations. e2 empty is REAL (a fresh user has Personal + root membership and no owned/joined orgs). e3 provisioning gate holds the switcher until user_role resolves — must never flash GUEST/empty mid-provision. e4 error keeps the previous active context and offers retry. e5: losing membership mid-session is a 403 ACCESS_LOST rendered IN PLACE — the row is dropped and the user returns to Personal; NEVER a sign-in redirect (only 401 re-authenticates). e6: create-org NAME_TAKEN renders inline on the field.
